# Pacify v1.21.9

Your packet control mod for Minecraft. Built and delivered by [Hexa Studios](https://hexastudios.net).

---

## What is Pacify?

Pacify is a Fabric mod that gives you full control over GUI packets while any inventory is open. Inspired by the original [UI-Utils](https://github.com/Coderx-Gamer/ui-utils) mod — fully rewritten from scratch with new features and support for modern Minecraft versions.

---

## Features
- **Dialogs Support** — Pacify also supports the buttons when you are in a dialog!
- **Close without packet** — close any GUI client-side without notifying the server, auto-saves for restore
- **Restore GUI** — press V to reopen the last saved GUI client-side
- **De-sync** — send a close packet while keeping the GUI open client-side
- **Send packets toggle** — enable/disable all slot interaction packets
- **Delay packets** — queue packets and flush them all at once
- **Disconnect and send** — flush queued packets then immediately disconnect
- **Fabricate ClickSlot packet** — manually craft and send a ClickSlot packet with full field control
- **Fabricate ButtonClick packet** — manually craft and send a ButtonClick packet
- **Dialog screen support** — Pacify now works with dialog screens
- **Copy GUI Title JSON** — copy the current GUI title as a JSON text component
- **Chat field** — chat or run commands while inside any GUI
- **`^togglepacify` command** — toggle Pacify's in-game rendering from the chat field

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft Fabric
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

---

## Planned releases

- 1.21.10
- 1.21.11
- 26.1

---

## Installation

1. Download the `.jar` from the assets below
2. Place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder
3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric

---

## Credits

Inspired by the original [UI-Utils](https://github.com/Coderx-Gamer/ui-utils) by Coderx Gamer. Fully rewritten and maintained by [LyamRay](https://github.com/lyamray) at [Hexa Studios](https://hexastudios.net).
